description: Secure-mode server cases for SECURITY.md §5 (authenticated hello). Format: see README.md, section 'Secure server cases'. Run over wss:// with the fixture's key; the runner verifies the pin.

cases.name: hello_valid_token
cases.description: A hello with a paired PC's token succeeds, and the result names that PC in pc.

cases.name: authenticated_list_sensors
cases.description: After an authenticated hello the session works as in dev mode.

cases.name: hello_without_auth
cases.description: Secure mode: a hello without auth is -32010, then the server closes with 1008.

cases.name: hello_auth_null
cases.description: auth: null counts as absent.

cases.name: hello_auth_not_object
cases.description: Choice: a malformed auth member is an authentication failure (-32010 and close), not -32602.

cases.name: hello_auth_without_token
cases.description: auth without token.

cases.name: hello_empty_token
cases.description: An empty token.

cases.name: hello_token_not_string
cases.description: Choice: a token of the wrong type is an authentication failure too.

cases.name: hello_unknown_token
cases.description: A well-formed token that no PC was given.

cases.name: hello_revoked_token
cases.description: The token of a PC that was revoked.

cases.name: hello_token_prefix
cases.description: A prefix of a valid token is not valid (the comparison is over the whole token).

cases.name: hello_unsupported_protocol_valid_token
cases.description: An authenticated hello with an unknown protocol is -32004 with data.supported, and the connection stays open.

cases.name: hello_unsupported_protocol_without_token
cases.description: Choice: auth is checked before the protocol version, so an unauthenticated client learns nothing and is closed.

cases.name: hello_invalid_params_before_auth
cases.description: Choice: step 7 (params shape, protocol required) comes before the auth check; -32602 does not close the connection.

cases.name: hello_missing_protocol_with_token
cases.description: protocol is still required.

cases.name: request_before_hello
cases.description: The -32003 rule of PROTOCOL.md §3 still applies before a successful hello; it does not close the connection.

cases.name: unknown_method_before_hello
cases.description: Unknown methods get -32003 before hello too.

cases.name: hello_notification_ignored
cases.description: A hello without id is a notification: no reply, no close, and it doesn't authenticate.

cases.name: rehello_with_bad_token
cases.description: A later hello with a bad token after a successful one is still -32010 and closes the connection.

cases.name: no_hello_timeout
cases.description: SHOULD: a connection that sends nothing is closed with 1008 after the hello timeout.
